emailEntry.title: Join the interview
emailEntry.subtitle: Enter your email to receive a link and continue on any device.
emailEntry.enterEmailDesc: Enter your email to receive a secure link to start your interview. No password needed.
emailEntry.emailNote: We use your email to save your progress so you can resume later. We won't send anything else.
emailEntry.sendError: We couldn't send your link. Please check your email address and try again.
emailEntry.resendError: We couldn't resend the link. Please try again.
emailEntry.skipEmailNote: You won't be able to resume on a different device.
emailEntry.trustLine: Your responses are encrypted and stored securely.
emailEntry.whyEmailToggle: Why we ask for your email
emailEntry.whyEmailBody: We use your email so you can pause and resume the interview from any device. We won't add you to any list.

emailSent.title: Check your inbox
emailSent.desc: We sent a secure link to {{email}}. Click the link in the email to start your interview.
emailSent.expiry: The link expires in 30 minutes. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.

consent.title: Before you begin
consent.welcomeBackRecent: We've got your profile from {{days}} days ago — feel free to jump straight in.
consent.welcomeBackGeneric: We've got your profile on file — feel free to jump straight in.
consent.desc: This interview is conducted by AI. Your responses will be recorded and analysed to help improve products and services.
consent.dataUse: Your data will be processed according to the
consent.consentLabel: I agree to participate and have my responses recorded
consent.panelConsentLabel: I'd like to join the research panel to be invited to future studies
consent.declinedDesc: You can close this page. Your participation is entirely voluntary — thanks for your time.
consent.listRecorded: Your voice will be recorded and transcribed by AI.
consent.listReviewed: Your responses will be reviewed by the research team.
consent.listVoluntary: Participation is voluntary — you may stop at any time.
consent.listSecure: Your data will be stored securely and used only for research purposes.
consent.panelJoinDesc: Get invited to future paid studies that match your profile
consent.panelJoinNote: We'll save your profile securely. You can opt out any time.
consent.byParticipating: By taking part in this study you agree to the following:

profile.title: Tell us a bit about yourself
profile.subtitle: This helps us match you with relevant future studies. All fields are optional.
profile.minSubtitle: Just your first name — your AI moderator uses it to address you naturally during the interview.

micPrompt.title: This interview uses your microphone
micPrompt.subtitle: When you click below, your browser will ask for microphone permission. Click Allow — this is required to record your answers.
micPrompt.step2: Click Allow in your browser's permission prompt
micPrompt.step3: Say something to confirm your mic is working
micPrompt.note: Your audio is only recorded when you actively press the record button.

micTest.title: Quick mic check
micTest.desc: Say anything to test your microphone before we begin.
micTest.descClear: Say a few words out loud — just so we know your mic is working.
micTest.speakPrompt: Speak to see your mic level…
micTest.listening: We can hear you — keep going
micTest.permissionDeniedDesc: This interview requires microphone access. Please allow it in your browser settings, then refresh.
micTest.permissionDeniedIOS: On iPhone/iPad, go to Settings → Safari → Microphone and allow access for this website.
micTest.permissionDeniedChrome: Click the camera icon in the address bar → Allow microphone, then refresh.
micTest.permissionDeniedSafari: Go to Settings → Safari → Microphone → Allow for this website, then refresh.
micTest.permissionDeniedFirefox: Click the lock icon in the address bar → Permissions → Microphone → Allow, then refresh.

screening.title: A few quick questions before we begin
screening.subtitle: These help ensure the study is a good fit for you.
screening.submissionError: Something didn't work as expected. Please try again.

screening.submissionErrorServer: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again — if this keeps happening, reach out to your researcher.
screening.submissionEscalation: Still having trouble? Reply to the email that brought you here.

disqualified.title: Thank you for your time
disqualified.desc: This study is looking for a specific audience — you're not the right fit for {{projectName}} right now.
disqualified.desc2: That's completely fine. Your answers helped us confirm we're reaching the right participants.
disqualified.emailNote: If other studies open up that match your profile, we may reach out to {{email}}.
disqualified.close: You can safely close this page.
disqualified.futureStudiesNote: Reply to the email that brought you here and we'll keep you in mind.
disqualified.contactMistake: Think this is a mistake? Reply to the email that brought you here.
